field_principles.edit_targets_used: model weights must not be silently changed
field_principles.family_holdout_delta: learning must generalize to related held-out cases
field_principles.fr11_soundness_bounded_ready: matrix v21 needs a machine-readable FR-11 result
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal verdict must start with a success prefix unless blocked
field_principles.inference_substrate: exact controller update must not be confused with live LLM inference
field_principles.mistake_budget_delta: online learning must be checked against budget
field_principles.no_feedback_delta: feedback effect must beat no-op control
field_principles.prior_retention_delta: self-learning must not forget known cases
field_principles.promotion_decision: controller-only vs stronger claims must be separated
field_principles.self_model_trace_count: process feedback must be stored, not inferred
field_principles.shuffled_control_delta: feedback effect must beat randomized labels
field_principles.source_trace_counts: learned updates must trace to feedback sources
